source: Editorial task: brief station users on a locker trial. Six stations tried numbered lockers in July; lost-item reports fell from 18 to 11. Staffing and opening hours also changed. The note does not isolate a cause. No decision about expansion has been made.

idea.title: What the station locker trial observed
idea.description: Explain the July trial and its limits.
idea.rationale: Numbered lockers caused the fall in lost-item reports.
idea.evidence: Six stations; reports 18 to 11; staffing and hours changed.
